1652: /// The outcome of a machine-health update: written, skipped (nothing to record), blocked by a lock
1653: /// timeout, or a write failure (wave 26c D2, wave 27c D7). Every non-`Written`/`Skipped` outcome
1654: /// carries a cause the caller names in `machine-wide health not updated (<cause>)`.
1655: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
1656: pub enum HealthUpdate {
1657:     /// The file was updated.
1658:     Written,
1659:     /// Nothing to record (no fingerprint, an operator-class failure, or no usable outcome/failure).
1660:     Skipped,
1661:     /// `<file>.lock` could not be acquired within the retry budget (`MachineHealthLastError`).
1662:     LockTimeout,
1663:     /// The lock was held but the read-modify-write itself failed (serialize/atomic-write); the
1664:     /// string is the cause (wave 27c, D7).
1665:     Failed(String),
1666: }
1667: 
1668: impl HealthUpdate {
1669:     /// (wave 27c, D7) The cause to name in the warning, or `None` for `Written`/`Skipped`.
1670:     pub fn cause(&self) -> Option<String> {
1671:         match self {
1672:             HealthUpdate::Written | HealthUpdate::Skipped => None,
1673:             HealthUpdate::LockTimeout => Some("lock timeout".to_string()),

1676:     }
1677:     /// Whether the update did not happen for a real reason (a cause the caller warns about).

+  journal is only ever emptied WHOLE, never rewritten in place: when an unreadable line cannot be
